answer: Every usable unit of credit is a countable attestation from a stranger, and moving that credit to another identity spends it, which makes credit a strictly diminishing resource rather than a property clones can duplicate. Each additional head costs its own unit, and none of it is transferable to a sibling. Treat credit as a bridge that only outsiders can mint, a juniper that rejects kin, and a delta that is spent on use: the farm owns many keys and zero bridge, and no amount of juniper or delta can be self-issued. Each usable unit of credit needs one honest stranger.
